_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#9 — RESTARTEVERY is declared in BOTH the IO section (src/inpar/4C_inpar_io.cpp, default -1) and STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC (src/inpar/4C_inpar_structure.cpp), but the structural integrator reads only the STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC one (src/structure_new/src/4C_structure_new_timint_basedataio.cpp:81).
